name: Joel
overview: Joel was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin who served as an overseer of the Benjamites. He lived in Jerusalem, indicating his role was likely connected to the community there. His leadership position highlights his significance within the Benjaminite tribe during his time.
namesAndTitles: The name Joel means 'y-h-v-h is G-d [El],' reflecting a theophoric element common in Hebrew names. This proper name emphasizes the acknowledgment of God's sovereignty but was not given by God directly to Joel.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Joel was the father of Zichri, establishing a direct familial link. No other family relationships beyond his son are mentioned, so his family details remain limited to this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Joel's role as overseer of the Benjamites situates him as a key leader within the tribe of Benjamin, responsible for governance or organization among his people. Living in Jerusalem further underscores his involvement in the central community of Israel. Through his leadership, Joel contributed to the structure and order of the Benjaminite tribe during the post-exilic period.
